paragraphs: The paternal grandfather of Rabbi Chiyya and his siblings, as in [Sanhedrin 5a](https://www.sefaria.org/Sanhedrin.5a.12).[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked passage names Rabbi Chiyya and his siblings as children of Abba bar Acha Karsala.
Hyman’s heading gives Acha bar Sala or Karsala. The linked Bavli has Acha Karsala.
